text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Visiting the shopping district on a day 
off, I heard frantic voices coming from 
nearby.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I made an ordering 
mistake... There's no way we can sell 
through this massive amount of rice! What 
do I do...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that is tough... but don't look so 
down. Anyone can make a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Besides, irregularities can be solved with 
ideas. It's fine, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, let's put up the poster... 
――Alright!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hii, who wants a one-coin bento~? And for 
just one extra coin, get a mega-sized 
mega-rice upgrade!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's no actual little 
doggie inside, so please dig in with peace 
of mind~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if it isn't Pearl-senpai, desu! What 
you're selling is... bento boxes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, that portion size for that price? What 
a great deal♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! I was just thinking of grabbing 
lunch, desu. One mega-rice portion bento, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪ One mega-rice upgrade two-coin 
bento, sold!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... I never imagined the horse 
girl students would buy this much!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, broaden your perspective and 
opportunities are everywhere. Never give 
up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that to myself, I left the 
shopping district, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After arriving at the shopping mall 
shortly after, there was a strangely 
familiar mannequin――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...? No, looking closer, that's――!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿¡Qué!? Pearl-senpai!? What on earth are 
you doing this time, desu...?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: T-This is... quite startling, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Nffufu♪ We meet again, you two.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...To tell the truth, a clerk I know broke 
their mannequin. So I'm currently working 
a part-time gig as a temporary mannequin.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard of a part-time job like 
that in my life, desu!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The world is full of variety. ...Whoops, 
since I'm a mannequin right now, I 
shouldn't talk any more♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: S-She went quiet all of a sudden, desu...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then... perhaps we should excuse 
ourselves before we disturb her. See you 
later, Pearl-senpai.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai, you were amazing today, 
desu...! Are your days off always like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ――You see, I don't want anyone to 
give up on their possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I prove it through my own 
actions. "As long as you never give up, 
the path will open"... like that!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hearing it from you, Pearl-senpai, 
makes me genuinely want to believe it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
――Oh, I got a message from the two people 
I helped today. "Thank you," they say. It 
feels nice♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A conviction to never give up on 
possibility. It made me excited for her 
own boundless potential as well.
